name: Serial Position Effect
axiom: Humans recall items positioned at the beginning and end of sequences most reliably.
trigger: Critical navigation or actions sit mid-list and are overlooked while first and last items dominate attention.

checklist.text: Put critical destinations at the far left or top and far right or bottom of navigation.
Place core value propositions in the first rows and conversion actions in the last.
Pin frequent dropdown options to the top and summary categories to the bottom.

antiPattern.violation: A 12-item flat navigation menu buries the primary analytics dashboard in the middle.
antiPattern.remediation: Place Dashboard first and Settings last, matching where scanning memory is strongest.

academicOrigin.title: The Serial Position Effect of Free Recall
